inputs.text: This latest lawsuit attacking ICE for detaining thousands of people as they leave immigration courts is just another progressive effort to tie the hands of law enforcement and erode our national borders. The claim that ICE lawyers relied on false information by citing a memo from May of last year, which court documents now say gave no authorization, shows how these activist cases twist technicalities to protect people seeking legal status they have no real claim to. We need strong authority and enforcement to maintain social order, not more challenges that undermine personal responsibility and allow outsiders to game the system at the expense of American families and cultural continuity.
